feature: adapter-owned fixed-shape Core ML projection executor and owned M3 diagnostic

sources.use: Public API documentation and source reviewed 2026-10-15: CompiledMLModel prediction, CPU_AND_NE policy, MLComputePlan structure traversal, MIL conversion and compile_model. Original implementation; no source copied.
Evidence boundary: MLComputePlan describes anticipated placement and cannot by itself establish observed Neural Engine execution. No source copied.

modifications: Original immutable artifact/shape/minimum-memory contract; bounded regular-file compiled-byte binding and hash-verified private snapshot; lazy Core ML import; strict finite fp16 prediction and serialized close; native float16/float32 bridge validation followed by an owned float16 copy; nested compute-plan recording that never promotes anticipated placement to observed execution. Added an M3-only synthetic MIL projection probe with full-output float32 reference parity, existing CPG/radio plus paired-lock validation, process supervision and atomic external evidence.

limitations: No serving adapter selects this route yet; direct executor calls are explicit selection only.

coremltools is absent from the primary development virtualenv, so CPU tests use a fake runtime. An external owned Apple M3 Pro run with Core ML Tools 9.0 compiled the deterministic synthetic model and completed six predictions with exact numerical parity.
The native Core ML bridge exposed the fp16 output feature as float32. The executor validated it and returned an owned fp16 copy; unsupported dtypes and fp16-overflowing values fail closed.

The compiled Core ML model and artifact-bound M3 receipts are retained outside the repository at private validation evidence Artifact SHA-256 is 613daabdc7a829dd1da0b9c52774e3778690704b54eb60117217510120fee971; compiled tree SHA-256 is 2511521fdfd14eb177267f1b7bbaea24b5d10684fadef6e1be0625ba19fe49c4.
Core ML Tools 9.0 in the M3 diagnostic did not expose coremltools.models.MLComputePlan, so anticipated placement was unavailable and actual execution device was not observed.
CPU_AND_NE permission and MLComputePlan anticipated placement are not post-execution Neural Engine evidence; observed_used remains false even though native prediction completed.

Synchronous Core ML prediction has no cancellation contract here. Probe timeout terminates/reaps the worker; uninterruptible OS work retains its supervisor and ownership until exit. Process exit does not prove Core ML daemon/device drain.

Declared tensor bytes are a minimum, not native peak memory. The regular-file copy is capped at 64 MiB and 4096 entries. Filesystem metadata and ownership validation are not universal hard deadline operations.
No asynchronous serving integration, trained model head, automatic fallback, quality qualification or performance claim is included.
